integrity: All reproducibility material included; finite diagnostic checks are not a proof of asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Real Boolean cube, homogeneous degree three only. Second coefficient is lattice-phase dependent; a uniform O(1) remainder is proved, not a complete constant-order expansion. Exact projection reduction and leading Gaussian constant are prior work. Undiscovered equivalent binomial/Krawtchouk formulations remain possible.
title: Cubic Walsh projection constants have two-root lattice fluctuations
